nphi.title: CDC Caribbean and Central America Regional Office (CCAMRO)
nphi.with: Caribbean Public Health Agency (CARPHA) and its Reference Laboratory; Council of Ministers of Health of Central America (COMISCA); Gorgas Memorial Institute; SENACYT; INDICASAT
nphi.summary: Launched in 2024 in Panama City, CDC's CCAMRO covers 21 countries, working with CARPHA, COMISCA and Panama's Gorgas Memorial Institute on early warning, surveillance, laboratory strengthening and emergency response capacity.

nphi.title: COVIGEN/RESVIGEN – Regional Genomic Surveillance Network for respiratory viruses
nphi.with: Regional sequencing labs: Fiocruz; ISP Chile; INS Colombia; Inciensa; InDRE; Gorgas; University of the West Indies; US CDC
nphi.summary: PAHO network created in 2020 with eight regional sequencing laboratories, mostly national public health institutes, supporting countries to adopt routine genomic surveillance of SARS-CoV-2, influenza and RSV.

nphi.title: REDSUR – South American Field Epidemiology Network
nphi.with: Instituto Nacional de Salud (INS) Colombia (coordinator); TEPHINET; national FETPs of member countries
nphi.summary: REDSUR, the South American network of FETPs created in 2011 with CDC support, is coordinated by Colombia's INS, which hosted CDC and TEPHINET to plan expansion of field epidemiologists across the region.

nphi.title: PulseNet Latin America and the Caribbean (PNALC)
nphi.actor: ANLIS Dr. Carlos G. Malbrán – INEI Bacteriology (regional coordinator)
nphi.with: PAHO; US CDC PulseNet International; CARPHA (for its member states); national public health laboratories
nphi.summary: Molecular subtyping network for foodborne disease surveillance founded in 2004, regionally coordinated by INEI-ANLIS Malbrán with PAHO, linking national laboratories of 16 countries plus CARPHA within PulseNet International.

nphi.title: CDC Central America regional office (Guatemala)
nphi.with: Ministries of health; Regional Network of National Laboratories; Universidad del Valle de Guatemala (advanced FETP); Central America FETP
nphi.summary: CDC's presence in Central America dates to the 1960s and was strengthened in 2003 with a programme office in Guatemala supporting ministries of health in seven countries on surveillance, the Regional Network of National Laboratories, FETP…

nphi.title: ReLAVRA+ – Latin American and Caribbean Network for Antimicrobial Resistance Surveillance (Malbrán as regional reference)
nphi.actor: ANLIS Dr. Carlos G. Malbrán – INEI (WHO Collaborating Centre for AMR)
nphi.with: PAHO; national reference laboratories of ReLAVRA+ member countries
nphi.summary: PAHO network established in 1996 in which Malbrán's INEI has served as regional reference laboratory, building AMR detection and quality-control capacity in national laboratories; it was designated a WHO Collaborating Centre in 2020.

nphi.title: Gorgas–JICA project to strengthen COVID-19 and disease surveillance and diagnostics
nphi.actor: Instituto Conmemorativo Gorgas de Estudios de la Salud (ICGES)
nphi.summary: Cooperation agreement signed in July 2021 for equipment, supplies and staff training to strengthen Gorgas's surveillance and diagnostic capacity, including its regional laboratories in Darién, Chiriquí and Veraguas, through 2023.

nphi.title: CREATE-NEO – Coordinating Research on Emerging Arboviral Threats Encompassing the Neotropics
nphi.actor: University of Texas Medical Branch (UTMB), NIAID CREID network
nphi.with: Research sites in the Brazilian Pantanal, Manaus and São José do Rio Preto, and in Panama
nphi.summary: NIAID-funded centre in the CREID network running arbovirus surveillance sites in Brazil and Panama, combined with modelling to anticipate emerging arboviral and zoonotic threats.

nphi.title: Fiocruz – Gorgas Memorial Institute (Panama) MoU
nphi.with: Instituto Conmemorativo Gorgas de Estudios de la Salud
nphi.summary: Cooperation MoU between Fiocruz and Panama's national health research institute, the Gorgas Memorial Institute.

nphi.title: ASPR–Gorgas cooperative agreement on IHR implementation and pandemic influenza preparedness
nphi.actor: US HHS Office of the Assistant Secretary for Preparedness and Response (ASPR)
nphi.with: Instituto Conmemorativo Gorgas de Estudios de la Salud (national public health laboratory); US CDC (coordination)
nphi.summary: Single-source cooperative agreement (about US$300,000–350,000, 2014–2017) to strengthen IHR (2005) implementation, pandemic influenza and emerging disease preparedness and detection in Panama and neighbouring Central America and the…

nphi.title: Gorgas–CDC project on influenza and respiratory infections in Central America and the Dominican Republic
nphi.actor: Instituto Conmemorativo Gorgas de Estudios de la Salud (ICGES)
nphi.summary: CDC-funded project (2013–2018) carried out by Gorgas on the epidemiology, prevention and treatment of influenza and other respiratory infections in Central America and the Dominican Republic.

nphi.title: FOGELA – laboratory quality management toward accreditation in Central America and the Dominican Republic
nphi.actor: Instituto Conmemorativo Gorgas de Estudios de la Salud (ICGES)
nphi.summary: SE-COMISCA/CDC project (2012–2013) in which Gorgas took part in strengthening quality management systems of public health laboratories toward accreditation, with regional workshops held in the Dominican Republic.

nphi.title: IAI-funded capacity building on climate and health in Ecuador, Panama and Peru
nphi.actor: Instituto Conmemorativo Gorgas de Estudios de la Salud (ICGES)
nphi.with: Inter-American Institute for Global Change Research (IAI)
nphi.summary: Project funded by the Inter-American Institute for Global Change Research to build technical and scientific capacity on climate change and health in Ecuador, Panama and Peru.

nphi.title: Gorgas–Cuban partners spatial model of malaria transmission in Madugandí
nphi.actor: Instituto Conmemorativo Gorgas de Estudios de la Salud (ICGES)
nphi.with: Centro del Clima (Cuba); Escuela de Salud Pública, Universidad de La Habana
nphi.summary: Joint project with Cuban climate and public health institutions to model the spatial dynamics of malaria transmission in Panama's Madugandí indigenous comarca.

nphi.title: Gorgas–NHRC strengthening of infectious disease surveillance in Panama, Central America and the Caribbean
nphi.actor: Instituto Conmemorativo Gorgas de Estudios de la Salud (ICGES)
nphi.summary: NHRC-funded project with Gorgas to strengthen infectious disease surveillance in Panama and the wider Central American and Caribbean region.

nphi.title: US HHS–Panama/Gorgas MoU on pandemic influenza preparedness
nphi.actor: US Department of Health and Human Services
nphi.with: Instituto Conmemorativo Gorgas (GMI); Ministerio de Salud de Panamá
nphi.summary: MoU signed in April 2006 between HHS, Panama's health ministry and the Gorgas institute to improve influenza surveillance and laboratory testing capacity and speed up outbreak investigation and response.
